title: Module 1 – Personal Website
overview: Built a Flask-based personal developer website using HTML and CSS to display a biography, projects, and contact information.
learning: Learned how Flask routing, HTML templates, and CSS work together to build a functional website.

title: Module 2 – Web Scraping
overview: Developed a web scraper to collect GradCafe admissions data using urllib and BeautifulSoup and stored it as structured JSON.
learning: Learned how to extract, clean, and structure data from HTML pages using Python.

title: Module 3 – Database Queries
overview: Loaded scraped data into a PostgreSQL database, wrote SQL queries for analysis, and displayed results in a Flask web application.
learning: Learned how to integrate databases with web applications and perform analysis using SQL.

title: Module 4 – Testing and Documentation
overview: Built a full Pytest suite with 100% coverage and created Sphinx documentation for the GradCafe analytics application.
learning: Learned how to write automated tests and document software for maintainability.

title: Module 5 – Software Assurance + Secure SQL (SQLi Defense)
overview: Improved application security by preventing SQL injection, enforcing safe queries, and using static analysis and dependency tools.
learning: Learned how to secure applications and enforce best practices in software assurance.

title: Module 6 – Deploy Anywhere
overview: Refactored the application into a microservices architecture using Docker, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, and a background worker.
learning: Learned how to build scalable systems using containerization and asynchronous processing.

title: Module 7 – Cloud Computing
overview: Built a cloud data pipeline using S3 and SageMaker and deployed a multi-container application to AWS EC2.
learning: Learned how to use AWS services and deploy applications in a cloud environment.

title: Module 8 – Data Preparation & Statistics
overview: Performed data cleaning, statistical analysis, and visualization of GradCafe data using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
learning: Learned how to analyze datasets, identify patterns, and create meaningful visualizations.

title: Module 9 – Data Preparation & Models
overview: Applied K-Means clustering to group similar program names using text vectorization and scikit-learn.
learning: Learned how to cluster textual data and reduce complexity in datasets.

title: Module 10 – Data Dashboard
overview: Built an interactive data dashboard using Dash and Plotly to answer a research question with visualizations.
learning: Learned how to design dashboards and communicate insights through visual storytelling.

title: Module 11 – MLOps Pipeline
overview: Implemented MLflow tracking for K-Means models to record experiments and compare results.
learning: Learned how to track machine learning experiments using MLOps tools.

title: Module 12 – Two-Layer Neural Network
overview: Built a two-layer neural network from scratch using NumPy to predict graduate admissions outcomes.
learning: Learned how neural networks work internally, including forward and backward propagation.

title: Module 13 – Scale & LM Deployment
overview: Fine-tuned a pretrained language model and deployed it in a Flask app to predict admissions outcomes from text and structured data.
learning: Learned how to integrate machine learning models into web applications and deploy them for real use.
